mentions.note: Surrey boys 4x100m winning team; surname printed lower-case 'warr'
Youth; competed in every Young Athletes League match and won every race he ran
aged 15; 200m p.b. 23.6; joint top points scorer in the Dunlop Young Athletes League
youth; match 1: 100 A 11.5, 200 A 23.3; match 2: 100m A 12.1, 200m A 24.9; match 3: 200m A 24.2, 100m A 11.7; HAC Trophy: 200 A 1st 23.6; first-choice sprint squad, never beaten in League sprints

photos.c: BELOW. Our winning Boys 4x100m team after the Surreys. Later in the season they went on to reduce the Club record to a fast 47.8. L to R; Bassam Zriek, Mark Dooley, Clive Gardne[illegible] and Gavin warr.
Back Page; 15 yr old Gavin Warr improved his 200m p.b. to 23.6 and was our top points scorer along with Clive Gardner in the Dunlop Young Athletes League.
